      • testOCPublishWithSomeAlreadyPublishedAttributes

        public void testOCPublishWithSomeAlreadyPublishedAttributes()
        This method will publish a set of handles, then, after they have been validated as being published, it will re-publish a set of attributes for the class. However, the set of attributes that is being republished will be different to that which was initially published. It will contain a new attribute, and will be missing an attribute that was previously published. It is expected that the set of attributes provided to the second publication will replace the set that was provided to the first.

      • testOCPublishInheritedAttributesFollowedBySuperClass

        public void testOCPublishInheritedAttributesFollowedBySuperClass()
        This test will first publish an object class, including some inherited attributes. It will then proceed to publish the parent class of the previously published object class. This is valid, and should result in the federate publishing both classes.

        Further, when publishing the parent class, some additional attributes that were not part of the original publication will be included. This should result in the federate publishing those attributes only for the parent class, and not the subclass (and vice versa).

      • testOCPublishSuperclassWithChildClassAttributes

        public void testOCPublishSuperclassWithChildClassAttributes()
        In this method, we attempt to publish attributes that are of a child class of the object class we have identified. For example, we attempt a publication identifiying ObjectRoot.A as the class, but include attributes from ObjectRoot.A.B. Obviously this should fail.

      • testOCPublishForPublishedTypeWithEmptyHandleSetAndOutstandingAcquisitionRequests

        public void testOCPublishForPublishedTypeWithEmptyHandleSetAndOutstandingAcquisitionRequests()
        Publishing with an empty set is the same as an implicit unpublish. Get an ownership acquisition request going and then try and publish with an empty set, which should cause an exception saying there is an outstanding acqusition request so we can't unpublish (explicitly or implicitly) at this time.

      • testOCPublishForPublishedTypeWithReducedAttributeSetAndOutstandingAcquisitionRequest

        public void testOCPublishForPublishedTypeWithReducedAttributeSetAndOutstandingAcquisitionRequest()
        Republishing for an object class will change the existing publication. For example, if you publish aa, ab and ac and then republish with only aa and ab, ac will be implicitly unpublished as a result. Get an ownership acquisition request up and going for an attribute and then implicity unpublish it through a republication without that attribute.
